# ORSPEX

> ORSPEX builds practical Windows software for small businesses.
> Two products: ORSPEX Business Suite (paid ERP) and ORSPEX PDF Compressor (free).

## Products

- [ORSPEX Business Suite](https://orspex.netlify.app/#features): All-in-one ERP for small businesses. Accounting, inventory, manufacturing, sales, purchasing, VAT. Windows 10/11. One-time $50. Runs offline.
- [ORSPEX PDF Compressor](https://orspex.netlify.app/#free-tool): Free Windows tool to compress PDF files locally. No uploads, no accounts. Open source.

## Key facts

- Business Suite price: $50 one-time
- No subscriptions, no per-user fees
- Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
- Runs offline — no internet required
- Data stays on the user's PC
- 30-day money-back guarantee
- Free updates for 12 months
